column1: # Edges removed by the Q12 inversion (ADR-070 §13, option a, user-approved 2026-11-15).
# The four columns match the graph format; the last one names the field that goes.
# Removing these from edges-all.tsv must make the native bucket acyclic — that is the
# whole point of the plan, and graph.sh checks it in scc-after.txt.
# Context = the field site's own build tag. Inverted rows are claims-only: the subset predicate
# enforces the inversion (README § claims.tsv; ADR-070 §15.2). A target row may never legitimize
# an edge an inverted row forbids.
